submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce one native 1254 x 1254 opaque square game-map patch for a seamless Chinese Taoist chibi hand-painted daytime city. Image 1 is the exact coordinate/layout guide for this patch r07_c07/s01_03_native01; image 2 is a wider layout-only orientation reference, not an image to reproduce at full extent. Fill precisely image 1's field of view at exactly 1254 x 1254. World box [26509, 24461, 27763, 25715], center core crop [115,115,1139,1139]. Sharp existing native CORE anchor bands at image-1 pixel boxes [[0, 0, 1254, 115], [1139, 115, 1254, 1139]] are authoritative neighboring artwork; preserve their line positions, color, stone/wood scale and continuation. The blurry remainder supplies geometry only: render fresh crisp native details throughout that area. Continue all crossing edges smoothly with unchanged scale and camera, without rectangular borders or shifted intersections. Close-up of the existing monumental red lacquered entrance pillar and its rounded warm gold foot. The tall pillar occupies the right-center; gold bands and plinth foot at about y=600..1000; pale stone platform below. The red wooden material at the top must continue downward seamlessly with the same vertical edge positions, no abrupt change at y=115. A gray stone support and red trim occupy the far left. Keep lion-head gray stone contours that enter from the right strip exactly continuous; only the cropped left side of the lion belongs at far right. Continue stone block courses visible in the upper right strip into the backdrop. Preserve the close-up crop and layout; no extra lions, faces, text or objects. Warm hand-painted natural pale gray/blue-gray ground, jade/teal architectural accents where shown, restrained warm gold, subtle soft natural daytime shading matching anchors. Preserve the approved layout and existing objects only. No added people, writing, UI, new decorative items, trees, lamps or buildings. No lettering, crop marks, watermarks, fake detail from enlargement, blur, haze or dense noise. Output only the finished full square patch, no collage or comparison.
